summary: This directory centralizes the definition and configuration of specialized agents designed to interact with external tools for retrieving public holiday information within defined timeframes.
responsibilities: Defining the logic and configuration for holiday-related agents
Integrating holiday data retrieval tools into agent workflows
Processing date-based requests for public holiday information
relationships: The holiday agent utilizes the getHolidayTool to fetch external data based on specific date constraints.
The agent acts as the interface between user requests and the underlying holiday data retrieval logic.
designDecisions: Encapsulation of holiday retrieval logic within a specialized agent instance
